semanticLock.waterGeometry: Flow × Boundary × Pressure × Memory is a deformation/state signature; Water transport also carries curvature, hysteresis and residual information. Water Geometry is not reduced to static shape.
semanticLock.wovenContinuity: Identity is recoverable relational/path correspondence through transformation, not mere visual or coordinate similarity.
semanticLock.violet: Violet is the software transfiguration/re-expression layer with future-preservation semantics. R265 does not claim one universal physical Violet equation.
semanticLock.dimensionalRelativity: Whole/part, inner/outer, observer, resolution and representation are frame-relative roles. 12^k values are computational address/resolution levels unless independently established as physical quantities.
semanticLock.orientation: Inverse/outverse sign/orientation is factored from structural state. Reversing orientation does not silently rewrite invariant structure.
semanticLock.scarHistory: Scar/history is carried and provenance-bound; it is never silently reset during skin or frame translation.
semanticLock.proof: Round-trip or commuting-transform proof requires measured residuals. Internal coherence never becomes external empirical proof automatically.

skins.FUNCTION: Preserve declared inputs/outputs, invariants and residuals.
skins.COMPUTE: Apply Water + Woven + Violet + frame translation as one state envelope.
skins.ORGANIZE: Partition and repartition by dependency, frame and active resolution.
skins.LEARN: Learn only from explicit outcomes or observed transitions; unchosen candidates are not failures.
skins.RENDER: Render projections without mutating CanonState or evidence.
skins.EXECUTE: Keep execution receipts separate from scientific truth and source promotion.
skins.SELF_BUILD: Use R265 for planning/evaluation cycles while R240 retains exact source mutation/promotion.
skins.EVIDENCE: Keep observed, returned, derived and inferred evidence classes distinct.
